claims.statement: The conversion procedure is GHES<3.21 only. The source introduction's granular organization permissions cannot grant cloud or modern GHES conversion support.

The converting personal account cannot belong to any organization and must leave memberships first; an enterprise policy may prevent conversion. Membership departure and enterprise permission are separate prerequisites.

Keeping personal information intact or retaining a same-name organization requires the alternative path: rename the personal account, create a new organization under the original name and transfer repositories. That is not irreversible conversion and inherits rename/transfer risks.

Automatic conversion first creates a replacement personal account for subsequent login and leaves memberships; settings navigation reaches Organizations and Transform account, then presents a warning and repeat conversion confirmation.

An organization owner must be selected as the replacement account or another trusted user. The last step signs into the new account and accesses the organization; owner selection alone does not verify current access or continuity.
The procedure may request subscription selection and billing information; documentation is not authority to incur costs or mutate billing. Those remain explicit approval boundaries.

The side-effects reference is reviewed separately; teams and organization-access links require their own review. No account creation, membership removal, rename, transfer, conversion or subscription change is performed.
